page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data.

The CPU allocation is fully dedicated, ensuring consistent processing capabilities without resource sharing. There are no integrated GPUs or hardware accelerators present on this instance. Additionally, it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 memory-to-CPU ratio positions this instance as a resource-dense option for compute-heavy tasks that do not demand large memory footprints. It is suitable for workloads such as web serving, lightweight application servers, batch processing, and basic computational tasks.
